summary: DASH-15 & DASH-25 Testing Complete. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: All features verified working. Revenue Trend Chart renders with dual Y-axes (Revenue INR left, Units Sold right). Offline Banner appears/disappears correctly on network events.

API_endpoint.notes: GET /api/analytics/executive-revenue-trend returns 200 with {labels, revenue, units} arrays

API_structure.notes: Response has labels (YYYY-MM-DD dates), revenue (numeric), units (numeric) - all same length

API_filters.notes: Accepts start_date, end_date, categories, channels, regions filter params

Frontend_chart.notes: Chart.js Line chart renders with data-testid='revenue-trend-chart'

Dual_Y_axes.notes: Left Y-axis: Revenue (₹) in blue, Right Y-axis: Units Sold in green

Chart_title.notes: Title: 'Revenue Trend', Description: 'Daily revenue & units sold over the selected period'

Data_display.notes: 90 data points from Jan 1 to Mar 31, 2026. Revenue range ₹50L-60L, Units range 2700-3300

Component_exists.notes: OfflineBanner component in App.js with data-testid='offline-banner'

Hidden_when_online.notes: Banner not in DOM when navigator.onLine is true

Shows_on_offline.notes: Banner appears when window 'offline' event is dispatched

Hides_on_online.notes: Banner disappears when window 'online' event is dispatched

Banner_styling.notes: Red background, white text, wifi-off icon, z-index 100 (above all content)

Banner_message.notes: Text: 'You are offline. Some features may be unavailable until your connection is restored.'

KPI_cards.notes: 4 KPI cards: Revenue (₹49.6Cr), Units (265K), MRP Realisation (99.6%), Health Score (25.8)

WoW_card.notes: Week-over-Week comparison: -0.2% revenue change, -1.5% units change

YoY_card.notes: Year-over-Year comparison: +0% (no data from same period last year)

Module_cards.notes: 6/6 module cards: ROS Gap, Stock-Out, DOH, Planogram, Replenishment, NOOS

Quick_links.notes: Quick navigation section with 12 module links
